episodes.title: The Poisoned Chalice
episodes.summary: Extremely ruthless and ambitious cardinal Rodrigo Borgia uses bribery to take advantage of the death of the current Pope and rise to the Papacy.

episodes.title: The Assassin
episodes.summary: Micheletto, Orsini's assassin is recruited by Cesare to defect into the service of Della Rovere who is trying to prove Rodrigo has taken on a mistress.

episodes.title: The Moor
episodes.summary: Rodrigo seeks funds through a profitable marriage for Lucrezia and charges a fee for safe haven; the Borgias host a Turkish prince.

episodes.title: Lucrezia's Wedding
episodes.summary: Lucrezia's wedding is a disaster; the Borgia children's mother arrives; Della Rovere seeks the aid of the Medici family.

episodes.title: The Borgias in Love
episodes.summary: Lucrezia has an affair with a stable boy; Cesare strikes a bargain with Machiavelli and takes action to rid Ursula of her husband.

episodes.title: The French King
episodes.summary: Della Rovere strikes a bargain with King Charles of France; Rodrigo attempts to thwart an invasion.

episodes.title: Death on a Pale Horse
episodes.summary: The invasion of France proceeds; Giovanni Sforza is poised to join the battle; Leonardo Da Vinci shares drawings and blueprints.

episodes.title: The Art of War
episodes.summary: The invaders capture a pregnant Lucrezia who charms King Charles; Pope Alexander VI awaits his fate.

episodes.title: Nessuno (Nobody)
episodes.summary: Alexander meets King Charles with humility; Charles abandons Della Rovere; Lucrezia gives birth in a convent.

episodes.title: The Borgia Bull
episodes.summary: Pope Alexander VI takes a new lover; a cache of ancient artifacts is discovered; Cesare and Juan's rivalry spills into the streets; Lucrezia tends her newborn child; Della Rovere escapes an assassination attempt.

episodes.title: Paolo
episodes.summary: The father of Lucrezia's child travels to meet her in Rome; the Pope's lovers take him on a tour of Rome's indigent.

episodes.title: The Beautiful Deception
episodes.summary: Alexander VI refuses to allow a Catholic burial for Paolo; Lucrezia embarks on a hunger strike; the French army heads to Rome; Della Rovere sneaks into the city.

episodes.title: Stray Dogs
episodes.summary: Cesare recruits mercenaries to exact revenge on French troops; the pope forges strategic alliances; Lucrezia joins Giulia, who strives to aid the poor.

episodes.title: The Choice
episodes.summary: The Pope demands allegiance from Catherina Sforza; Alexander hears Savonarola while in disguise in Florence; Della Rovere attempts recruitment.

episodes.title: Day of Ashes
episodes.summary: Alexander begins a Lenten fast after fearing a sign from God; Cesare tries to prove his worth; the Pope pressures Lucrezia into another marriage.

episodes.title: The Siege at Forli
episodes.summary: Juan returns from Spain; Alexander plans to lay siege to Sforza's castle; Lucrezia scuttles a marriage scheme.

episodes.title: Truth and Lies
episodes.summary: Juan tries to spin his combat injury as proof of his valor; Lucrezia takes a lover; Della Rovere recruits a young friar.

episodes.title: World of Wonders
episodes.summary: Alexander prepares to end his fast with a celebration; Della Rovere's assassin becomes the Pope's taster; Lucrezia's lover proposes; Cesare makes a decision.

episodes.title: The Confession
episodes.summary: Cesare has a startling revelation; Lucrezia falls for a new suitor; Cesare cannot extract a confession; the assassin strikes.

episodes.title: The Face of Death
episodes.summary: Pope Alexander fights for his life; the cardinals fight for control of the papacy; Cesare and Micheletto track the assassin; Della Rovere prepares to make his move.

episodes.title: The Purge
episodes.summary: Pope Alexander seeks revenge against the cardinals; Rufio is ordered to rally support from the mercenary warlords; Lucrezia becomes annoyed with her future in-laws.

episodes.title: Siblings
episodes.summary: The purged Cardinals are stripped of their titles and wealth; King Ferdinand refuses to accept Giovanni; Cesare considers an alliance with the old enemy; Alexander sticks to his plan; Lucrezia is abandoned on her wedding night.

episodes.title: The Banquet of Chestnuts
episodes.summary: Cardinal Farnese discovers Versucci's theft; Alexander calls for a Crusade; Giulia arranges an orgy for the new Cardinals; King Ferdinand learns that Lucrezia's marriage has not been consummated.

episodes.title: The Wolf and the Lamb
episodes.summary: Cesare's diplomatic mission is a success; Bianca takes her own life; Alexander and Sforza conspire to repay Gonzaga; Lucrezia travels to Naples; King Ferdinand continues the refusal of recognizing Giovanni.

episodes.title: Relics
episodes.summary: Cesare lands in northern Italy; Catherina sends a plague-infested cloth to Alexander; Alexander taxes a newly arrived Jewish communtiy; Mattai gains the Pope's respect.

episodes.title: Lucrezia's Gambit
episodes.summary: Cesare burns Constanzo's palace to contain the plague; Lucrezia seeks a Neapolitan power base for herself; one of the candidates for Ferdinand's replacement is accused of trying to kill the other.

episodes.title: Tears of Blood
episodes.summary: Pilgrims travel to Rome for the Jubilee year celebrations; Catherina wants to hinder the festival; Mattai's contacts destroy a Turkish fleet; Lucrezia sees a change in Frederigo; Micheletto learns his lover is a spy.

episodes.title: The Gunpowder Plot
episodes.summary: Micheletto kills his lover and disappears; Cesare races to rescue Lucrezia; Alfonso begins to drink heavily; Alexander and Mattai scheme to corner the market in Italian sulphur.

episodes.title: The Prince
episodes.summary: Alexander and Cesare have reconciled; the Borgias are ready to move against their enemies; Catherina is determined to resist a siege; Cesare learns that Alfonso has become aggressive.
